visible_text:
下面的茎叶图显示一群文娛中心的会员的年龄分布。

 Stem (十位) | Leaves (个位) 
5 | 0 5 6 6 8
6 | 1 4 5 5 7 8 8 9
7 | 3 4 4 6 7 9
8 |
9 | 1

 从该群中随机选出一名会员。求所选出的会员的年龄不小于74的概率。

 A. 0.2
 B. 0.3
 C. 0.7
 D. 0.8
reasoning: Total members = 5 (stem 5) + 8 (stem 6) + 6 (stem 7) + 1 (stem 9) = 20. Ages ≥ 74 are: 74, 74, 76, 77, 79 (5 members from stem 7) and 91 (1 member from stem 9) → 6 members. Probability = 6/20 = 0.3, which corresponds to option B.
